source_clause: CW1.) The default screen for the Comfort widget is the Climate screen and includes driver and passenger temperature, auto button, sync button, Max A/C, and airflow modes. 12' Portrait 50% widget also includes fan speed.
reasoning: 驗證目標：17.2（CW1）定出 Comfort widget 之預設畫面為 Climate 畫面，並列出其所含之六類元素，八個 037 leaf 分別對應「預設畫面」「畫面包含以下」與六個元素，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）；其中 `-02`「screen includes:」為冒號引導句，**其可觀察量即該六元素之同時呈現**，故以一條驗六者俱在，與各元素之單獨條不重疊（§4.5：前者驗集合、後者驗個別元素之可操作性）。關鍵情境條件：依 **R-C34**，第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補；EMEA 排除補（ch16 無 widget 條文）；`-06`（MAX A/C）另補第四軸（MAX A/C 有無，出處 2.13），`-05`（SYNC）另補第二軸（非單區，出處 2.11）。為什麼這樣切：六個元素之失效互相獨立（AUTO 在而 SYNC 缺）。刻意略過：**`-08`（12" Portrait 50% widget 之風速）停下不產列** —— 螢幕尺寸與 widget 尺寸**不在 profile §3.2 之十五軸內**，依該節「配置軸不在既有軸內即停」；其來源問題即 **DR #6**（本次交付出哪幾種螢幕配置），未解。

tcs.tc_title: Comfort widget defaults to the Climate screen
tcs.test_item: The default screen for the Comfort widget shall be the Climate screen
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The Comfort widget is shown on the home screen
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Move the Comfort widget to its second screen and leave the home screen
2. Open the home screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The home screen is no longer displayed
2. The Comfort widget shows the Climate screen

tcs.tc_title: Climate widget screen shows all its listed elements
tcs.test_item: The Climate screen of the Comfort widget shall include driver and passenger temperature, auto button, sync button, Max A/C, and airflow modes
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The Comfort widget is shown on the home screen
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with MAX A/C, whose screens are used when CCM relays its presence (2.13)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a single zone climate configuration, for which Sync is not shown (2.11)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
6. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the home screen
2. Read the Climate screen of the Comfort widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Comfort widget shows the Climate screen
2. The driver temperature, the passenger temperature, the auto button, the sync button, Max A/C and the airflow modes are all shown
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
